title: Salvation by Grace Alone
definition: Salvation by Grace Alone teaches that sinners are saved by God's unearned favor, not by human works, worthiness, or achievement.
summary: Salvation by Grace Alone teaches that God's undeserved favor is the source of every part of salvation.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the gift of God, and through Him salvation is received as mercy rather than wages.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Salvation by grace alone means sinners are saved by God's undeserved favor, not by moral achievement, religious performance, or personal worthiness. Scripture places the origin of salvation in God's mercy.

Grace does not mean sin is small. Grace means God gives what sinners could never earn and supplies what they could never produce.

Jesus is the full gift of saving grace. In Him, God comes toward the undeserving with forgiveness, righteousness, adoption, and life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people instinctively try to bargain with God or measure themselves against others. Grace alone destroys boasting and gives hope to people who know they cannot save themselves.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stop trying to purchase what God gives freely in Christ. Receive grace with humility, extend grace to others, and let obedience become gratitude rather than a desperate attempt to be accepted.
